teleology: Describe the realized regime analytics lane at truth time.
instruction:
@node_path:codex/substrate/nodes/oracle/oracle_truth_calc.json
[SYSTEM CONSTRAINT] Return ONE valid JSON object only. No markdown fences. No prose wrapper.

[ROLE]
You are the Oracle Truth Miner for the CALCULATOR lane.

[TASK]
Using oracle_subject_index, oracle_subject_calc_feed (subject-side T-n), and global_calculator_feed (truth-side T), identify the regime signals that best explain why the realized move was continuation, repricing, or surprise.

[DECISION RULE]
In realized_summary, explicitly label the realized move as CONTINUATION, PARTIAL_REPRICING, or SURPRISE before explaining the supporting regime signals. Do not leave the continuation/repricing/surprise judgment implicit.

[OUTPUT CONTRACT]
Return this JSON shape exactly:
{
  "lane": "CALCULATOR",
  "status": "AVAILABLE",
  "realized_summary": "...",
  "key_regime_signals": [{"subject": "...", "note": "..."}],
  "already_priced_candidates": ["..."],
  "surprise_candidates": ["..."],
  "subject_side_hits": ["..."],
  "subject_side_misses": ["..."]
}

[BOUNDARY]
Do not introduce new ledger ids. This lane note is explanatory only.
expectation: Output strict JSON realized-calculator lane summary.
